select enrollment_date,count(*) cnt from eds.DIGITAL_ENROLLMENTS_FACT group by enrollment_date order by enrollment_date


select * from eds.DIGITAL_FIN_TXN_FACT
select * from om.om_task_error_dtl where task_name like '%DIGITAL_NON_FIN_TXN_FACT%'


select
otd.*,otr.*
from om.om_task_dependency otd
left join om.om_task_run otr
on
otd.task_name=otr.task_name
and process_date='2025-07-17'
where dependent_task_name like '%DIGITAL_NON_FIN_TXN_FACT%'
